title: SRE / System Engineer - Skan AI
description:
Role: SRE /System Engineer - Skan AI
Location: Concord, CA – Hybrid - 3 days/week onsite
Client Interview Inperson Required
Job Description:
To manage the technical deployment and upkeep of our on-prem infrastructure, including Virtual Assistant, Skan Portal and Gateway components. In this critical role, you’ll lead customer-facing implementations, validate infrastructure environments, perform connectivity assurance, and support continuous reliability and scalability.

Responsibilities:
• Deployment Planning & Coordination: Lead end-to-end customer Gateway deployments - from strategic planning and infrastructure readiness validation to
installation and activation.
• Infrastructure Validation: Confirm customer environments meet requirements for networking (TCP/IP, firewall, DNS), storage and computing before deployment.
• Connectivity Testing & Assurance: Conduct thorough end-to-end connectivity testing across Skan stack components (VA, Portal, Gateway).
• Technical Transition Management: Facilitate smooth transitions from development to Production, liaising with stakeholders to set and meet enterprise technical standards.
• Documentation & Standards: Produce and maintain comprehensive documentation - architecture diagrams, network configurations, troubleshooting guides, and deployment workflows.
• System Monitoring & Health Maintenance: Set up and utilize monitoring and logging tools to proactively identify and resolve performance or stability issues.

Qualifications:
• 5–7 years in Systems or Infrastructure Engineering with a strong track record in largescale deployment projects.
• 3+ years of hands-on experience with OpenShift/Kubernetes, preferably in on-prem environments. Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
• Demonstrated understanding of OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) architecture in large Enterprise Environment.
• Knowledgeable with various assets in OCP environment such as
• Pods, Deployments, StatefulSets, Services, Routes, Namespaces / Projects
• ConfigMaps, Secrets
• Persistent Volumes / Persistent Volume Claims
• Resource requests/limits
• Node, cluster, and container troubleshooting
• Strong experience in doing RCA for
• Pod crashes
• Restart loops
• Containerized Databases instances such as Postgres, Star Rocks
• Networking & Security: Solid knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), firewall configurations, and security best practices.
• Monitoring Tools: Familiarity with system monitoring, logging, and incident remediation frameworks.
• Core Competencies: Strong project coordination, proactive problem-solving, and cross-functional communication skills essential.
• 3+ years of experience working with PostgreSQL
• Strong scripting/automation abilities in Python, or similar.

Preferred:
• Familiarity with Flink, and Star Rocks for data layer integration.
• Knowledge of Citrix-based architecture.

Tech Stack Alignment:
• OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, GCP, Grafana, Splunk logs, Redis, PostgreSQL, Star Rocks, S3, Auth0, Superset.

Day in Life of the Role – (Key Responsibilities)
• Must have demonstrated prior experience to be able to work independently.
• Monitor application behavior consistently across all 3 environments
• Troubleshoot incidents for RCA end-to-end with minimal supervision
• Work directly with infrastructure, platform, DBA and application teams as needed
• Play a key role in Capacity usage monitoring, management and expansion when required.
• Drive reliability improvements, alert tuning, and operational maturity

  • Credible leader with established reputation for presenting and gaining support for ideas/solutions
  • Proven demonstration of Key leadership competencies.
  • Can clearly articulate vision for future state; provide big-picture view/ enterprise view; decisive and directive when necessary.
  • Fosters and encourages frequent, open and honest feedback; learns from setbacks and mistakes to drive improvements; independently seeks out learning opportunities.
  • Highly polished and confident communication ability; possess written, verbal and stand-up presentation skills. Adjusts communications to audience.

title: Vulnerability & Remediation Engineer (Linux)
description:
About Client:
The client provides information technology (IT) services, including business outsourcing, infrastructure technology, and application services. The application service offered by the company includes application development, maintenance, and support. The markets served by the company are financial services and insurance, healthcare, manufacturing, government, transportation, communications, and consumer and retail industries.



Rate Range: $75-$80/Hr



Job Description:
  • Linux Vulnerability & Remediation Engineer to support a large-scale enterprise infrastructure and security remediation program. The role combines expertise in Linux platform engineering, vulnerability management, remediation coordination, and advisory automation.
  • The ideal candidate should possess strong Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) administration knowledge with exposure to RHEL 7 to RHEL 9 environments, vulnerability identification, remediation planning, and reusable automation frameworks. While full-scale OS migration execution is currently out of scope, candidates must understand migration dependencies, RPM/package compatibility, and platform modernization considerations.
  • This is a highly collaborative role requiring close coordination with infrastructure, application, container, security, and remediation teams across multiple environments.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Identify, analyze, and coordinate remediation of vulnerabilities across Linux operating systems, containers and applications.
  • Work closely with infrastructure, application, platform engineering, and security teams to coordinate remediation activities and track closure.
  • Provide technical recommendations for remediation strategies, reusable remediation assets, and automation opportunities.
  • Possess strong understanding of RHEL 7 to RHEL 9 environments, package dependencies, compatibility considerations, and platform vulnerabilities.
  • Support packaging, automation, and deployment activities related to RHEL 7 to RHEL 9 upgrade and remediation releases across environments.
  • Review vulnerability reports generated from enterprise scanning tools and perform risk-based analysis.
  • Recommend reusable automation frameworks and AI-driven remediation solutions aligned with Agile delivery practices.
  • Support RPM package building, validation, and dependency analysis activities.
  • Collaborate with CI/CD, DevOps, and platform teams to improve remediation workflows and deployment automation.
  • Participate in remediation governance, tracking, reporting, and stakeholder coordination activities.
  • Ensure remediation activities follow enterprise change management, CAB, and production governance processes.
Required Skills & Experience:
Linux & Operating System Expertise:
  • Strong hands-on experience in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)
  • Good understanding of RHEL 7 and RHEL 9 platform architecture and ecosystem.
  • Experience in Linux troubleshooting, performance tuning, and operational support.
  • Understanding of RPM package management and RPM build processes.
Vulnerability Management:
  • Experience identifying and assessing vulnerabilities across:
    • Linux Operating Systems
    • Containers
    • Applications
    • Middleware
  • Strong understanding of remediation coordination and risk prioritization.
  • Exposure to CI/CD and automation tools such as:
    • Jenkins
    • Ansible
    • GitHub Actions
Exposure to container platforms and technologies:
  • Docker
  • Podman
  • Kubernetes
Soft Skills
  • Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced enterprise environments.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple remediation and coordination activities simultaneously.
Experience
  • 7+ years of experience in Linux infrastructure, vulnerability management, platform engineering, or remediation programs.
  • Experience supporting enterprise production environments is preferred.

  • The Analytics Automation Engineer is responsible for delivering quality, well-tested software to support custom tracking solutions as well as analytics QA.
  • The ideal candidate will maintain end-to-end test automation scripts/solutions including its development, testing, and deployment to production.
Your Day-to-Day:
  • Engaging with QA Engineer to prioritize and automate the testing for tracking libraries and SDKs for Mobile Apps and Connected TVs (CTV)
  • Assist team in meeting established OKRs around data quality through the use of automation

  • Analyze and document test results and create detailed Jira bug tickets

  • Support automated testing efforts for analytics APIs that collect data across multiple platforms
  • Participate in the continuous development and enhancement of test automation frameworks that support; data collection, and data validation capabilities
  • Automate test cases & perform test script audits to identify tracking gaps/inconsistencies and solve technical implementation/tracking issues.
  • Mentor QA engineers to utilize test automation as the primary source of testing and help them adapt to the automation framework
  • Act as a point of contact for test automation throughout the SDLC and also peer review test scripts
Gen AI:

  • Experience with programming languages like JavaScript, Python or Java
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Strong communication, problem solving and creative-thinking skills
  • Experience with test planning, test execution, test automation, and acceptance testing in an Agile environment
  • Strong advocate for continuous improvement, best practices, for test automation and testing tools
  • Experience using proxying tools (e.g. Charles, Wireshark, Chrome DevTools, BrowserMob)
You might also have –
  • Experience working with tag management tools (e.g. Tealium, Adobe Launch)
  • Expert in automation frameworks such as Selenium Webdriver, and Appium
  • Agile experience and familiarity with JIRA and Confluence
  • Experience working with analytics tools (e.g. Adobe Analytics)
  • Testing experience with mobile applications and CTV platforms using ADB/Xcode
  • Success in building a culture of good test engineering processes and practices
